title: The Playlist of Cedar Falls
author: Freya Crane
blurb: Orsen Underhill, the new kid at a school built over something old, has spent twelve years being so careful it hurts. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
